allocator_protocol: Empty unused CUDA allocator cache once per condition before warmups; warmups discarded; reset peaks before each measured request, never empty_cache inside timing.
generation: greedy, eos disabled, fixed token budget, no logits-copy hooks
memory_scope: CUDA PyTorch allocator allocated/reserved/peaks, not whole-device memory or analytical cache payload; CPU memory is null.
prompt_recipe: CPU torch.Generator(seed+L), IDs uniform [8,V), first column BOS=1; all positions valid; copied to device before timing.
statistics: p50/p95 use NumPy linear quantiles; next-token latency pools N-1 intervals per repeat; throughput counts batch tokens.
timing_scope: Warm streaming generate API wall clock, synchronize at request/token boundaries; includes validation/cache allocation/forward/selection/output bookkeeping; excludes model load/tokenization/H2D and report writes.
